community.name: Munchkin Association Alumni
community.setting: A light modern fictional Oz, centered on Munchkin Country: orchard villages, blue-painted community rooms, the maintained yellow brick road, ordinary buses, phones, kitchens, workshops, and seasonal gatherings. Settlement names are invented local labels, not real locations or canonical geography.
community.fictional_notice: Entirely fictional authoring facts for a source-only generation lab. These are provisional planning premises, not extracted evidence, verified biographies, or scripted episodes. Any resemblance to real people is unintended.
assumptions: The association is an invented network of alumni from local shared learning workshops, not a real institution or a degree-granting school.
All 50 members are adult human residents of this version of Munchkin Country. Human adaptations of nonhuman Baum characters are provisional and do not assert book canon.

Twelve entries draw loosely on characters encountered in Baum's first Oz book; thirty-eight entries are original Munchkin residents. Each inspiration field identifies its category. Borrowed names and motifs do not imply canonical biographies.
Home values are fictional neighborhoods or settlements only; there are no real addresses, contact details, or personal identifiers.
Relationships list reciprocal acquaintance links only. They authorize no specific interaction, family tie, shared incident, or testimony.

Each experience_domains item is an open personal-activity prompt, not an event asserted to have happened. Each can support multiple later source accounts, targeting 3–8 later stories per member only after source material exists.
Backgrounds describe ordinary strengths, constraints, and learning interests. Do not convert them directly into evidence or preapproved stories.

The separate manual examples are author-authored style demonstrations outside roster canon; Rowan Bell is a fictional moderator in the examples and community-life source documents, outside the 50-member roster.
